svg.title: Step 7 mockup 27: The show runs itself: the phases of a session on a timeline, and the hype curve
svg.text: 27 · The show runs itself: the phases of a session, and how big its story is
Use case: a storyline preset on Moments' storyboards, one per phase, is started by the schedule; a story grows as its session nears. The crew only holds, skips or spotlights. Demo names only.
1 · The phases of one session on a timeline: when each starts, what it shows, how big it is
The day before, from the run of show
Session card: game art, time, places
About 10 min before the start, when
Lobby count, who is here, teams
called, scores as the crew enters
After the result, until the next
Standings, what is next, clips and
Lead-up with the finalists, the final
The hype curve: a story's size follows how close its session is
Small box in the rotation, long before and long after
2 · One screen layout, three frames of the same session story (Demo Arena 5v5, Sat 19:30)

g.text: Teams forming · Night Owls 5/5 · Team Alpha 4/5
Standings strip: 1 Player Five · 2 Demo Player · 3 Player Two

svg.text: A · Long before: a small box
Beside the rotation. Carries "scan to join".
B · As it nears: a larger panel
The rail widens; the lobby count shows.
C · Live (and result, finals): the hero
The story fills Screen's main zone.
3 · One dropdown on the session form; the desk only holds, skips or spotlights
Storyline presets on Moments' storyboards: one per phase
Editable in the step 4 storyboard builder
Nothing else to run: the schedule starts every phase
A session's phases are started by the schedule from the preset chosen on its form; nobody starts a phase
The size follows how close the session is: small long before and after, a panel as it nears, the hero
while live, for the result and for the finals.
The tournament ships the presets on Moments' storyboards (step 4); they are editable in the storyboard
Spotlight now fires one story at once; Hold keeps the current phase; Skip moves to the next. Only the
